test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 20 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

The police have apprehended the criminal.

options.text: The criminal had been apprehended by the police.
The criminal had been apprehend by the police.
The criminal was apprehended by the police.
The criminal has been apprehended by the police.

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **correct passive form** of the sentence *"The police have apprehended the criminal."* is *"The criminal has been apprehended by the police."*
 
• **In converting **an active sentence to its passive form, the object in the active sentence becomes the subject in the passive sentence.
 
• The verb **"have apprehended" **changes to **"has been apprehended"** in the passive voice to maintain the present perfect tense.
 
• The original subject** "the police"** becomes the agent of the action, introduced by the preposition "by".

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *'The criminal has been apprehended by the police.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's go through each of the options:
 
 
• *"The criminal had been apprehended by the police.*" Incorrect because the verb tense has changed from present perfect (have apprehended) to past perfect (had been apprehended).
 
• *"The criminal had been apprehend by the police."* Incorrect because of the grammar mistake in the verb form, it should be "apprehended" not "apprehend".
 
• *"The criminal was apprehended by the police." *Incorrect because this sentence is in the simple past tense, not the present perfect.
